objective: Repair clamp(value, lower, upper) in clamp.py so it returns the value constrained to the inclusive interval [lower, upper].
acceptance_criteria: For finite integer and floating-point inputs with lower <= upper, preserve values inside the interval, including either endpoint.
Return lower for values below the interval and upper for values above the interval; support negative and equal bounds.
Change only clamp.py, preserve the public function signature, and leave the required check unchanged.
